item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed progress on an earlier recommendation to improve WA Police’s internal investigation and review timeframes.
item.support:
The Commission made a commitment to review the action taken by WA 
Police in addressing this recommendation in 12 months' time.

item.text: The review examined an escalation process, a rapid investigation pilot and the planned revision of police integrity procedures.
item.support:
The 
establishment of both the escalation model and the RRI pilot aim to assist 
WA Police in expediting investigation outcomes.

item.text: The Commission acknowledged progress but concluded that the integrity manual and quality assurance process still needed review and the new initiatives were at an early stage.
item.support:
WA Police are yet to review the Integrity Framework Manual and QA 
process

item.text: The Commission kept the recommendation open and planned another update and further review.
item.support:
Despite the actions taken to date by WA Police, the Commission's 
recommendation will remain open.

item.quote:
